title: 3D World Builder
shortDescription: A cloud-connected 3D world builder where users place items, upload media, and share immersive worlds in real-time multiplayer rooms.
fullDescription: A feature-rich 3D world creation platform built from scratch. Users can build environments using a provided item library and enrich them by uploading images, videos, PDFs, and 3D models via a cloud API. Completed worlds can be shared with others and presented live in real-time multiplayer rooms. Built entirely from scratch with full cloud integration and real-time sync.

title: Monopoly
shortDescription: A fully-featured Monopoly game with vs AI, local and online multiplayer, complete rule implementation, and robust network error handling.
fullDescription: A complete Monopoly game built entirely from scratch — no third-party assets used. Implements every Monopoly rule and feature faithfully. Supports three modes: vs AI, local multiplayer, and online multiplayer with full network disconnection handling and error-proofing to ensure games always stay in sync. All game state is fully synchronized across clients.

title: Interactive Wall Games
shortDescription: Games projected onto a physical wall that players interact with in real space — a unique blend of gaming and installation art.
fullDescription: An interactive installation where games are projected onto a wall and players physically interact with the game in real space using motion detection. Designed as an engaging experience for events and public spaces. Completed in 2025.

title: Trigger Run
shortDescription: An online multiplayer third-person shooter with team deathmatch, battle royale, multiple weapons, characters, and a post-death spectate mode.
fullDescription: A full-featured online multiplayer shooter built for a client. Includes team deathmatch and battle royale modes, a diverse arsenal of weapons, multiple playable characters, and a spectate mode that activates after a player is eliminated. Built with robust network sync to ensure smooth gameplay across all players.

title: Ninja Hope
shortDescription: A Japanese-themed multiplayer boat battle game where players defeat opponents or capture their castle to win.
fullDescription: A Japanese-themed multiplayer strategy game played on boats. Players win by either eliminating all opponents or reaching and capturing their castle. Features online multiplayer with PlayFab as the cloud data backend and Firebase for real-time notifications. Built with a full network layer for reliable match management.

title: Bicycle Stunts
shortDescription: A physics-based bicycle stunt game with challenging tracks and trick mechanics.
fullDescription: A physics-driven bicycle stunt game featuring challenging courses and trick-based gameplay. Players navigate ramps, obstacles, and stunt zones to pull off impressive moves. Built with realistic physics simulation for satisfying bike handling.

title: Checkers
shortDescription: A 2D checkers game with complete rule implementation, multiplayer support, and PlayFab cloud data integration.
fullDescription: A fully-featured 2D checkers game implementing all official checkers rules. Supports both local and online multiplayer modes. Player data, stats, and progression are stored and synced via PlayFab, ensuring a consistent experience across sessions and devices.

title: VR Experience — Government Finance Agency
shortDescription: A confidential VR application developed for a government finance agency.
fullDescription: A virtual reality application developed for a government finance agency. Further details are confidential.

title: Insurance Mobile App — Government
shortDescription: A confidential mobile application developed for a government insurance body.
fullDescription: A mobile application developed for a government agency in the insurance sector. Further details are confidential.

title: Flutter × Unity — Multi-Game Platform
shortDescription: A Flutter shell app that lists and launches multiple Unity multiplayer games including ping pong, checkers, submarine runner, and knife cut.
fullDescription: A hybrid platform where a Flutter app serves as the game launcher and UI shell, embedding Unity for all gameplay. Games listed in Flutter — including ping pong, checkers, submarine runner, and knife cut — are played inside Unity with full multiplayer support across all titles. A clean architecture that separates app navigation from game runtime.
